title: Independently signed native enrollment bootstrap setup v1
description: Closed canonical sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON plus exactly one LF, at most 32768 bytes and depth4. Ed25519 signs domain ASCII(catchplate/native-enrollment-bootstrap-setup/v1) plus NUL plus canonical setup JSON without LF. Shape does not establish signature validity, current runtime policy, protected reservation/token ownership, namespace ownership, installation or enrollment permission. The setup is a public selected association; actual reservation, durable claims and final native receiving remain mandatory separate gates.

authorizerKeyId.description: Actual setup-authorizer DER SPKI digest, distinct from the delegation, runtime CA, caller issuer/key and target issuer/key roles. Actual policy and response key separation is enforced by the cold owner; this field is not the independent exact-PEM input pin.

policyRequirementsSha256.description: Hash of exact selected requirements original, at most 65536 bytes. Python signature verification does not establish runtime provenance; the native constructor derives the complete original from its actual current Snapshot and compares this commitment.

targetPrincipalId.description: Additionally bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes, exactly matching the genuinely admitted delegation and target request; not the authenticated caller identity.

expiresAtUnixSeconds.description: Current positive interval at most300 seconds, wholly within genuine delegation, target request and public capability-association expiry. Original processing is at most30 seconds and never renews this interval.

origin.description: Exact canonical HTTPS origin, lowercase DNS or canonical unicast literal IP, no credentials/path/trailing slash/query/fragment; omit default443 and include a canonical nondefault port. Runtime performs semantic parsing and exact re-encoding.
Host equals genuine delegation ingressHost, port equals the signed/cold endpoint port; IP origins require the sole selected endpoint address.

endpoint.description: Exact canonical unicast literal SocketAddr, equal to genuine delegation and independent cold public TCP pin, never a vsock CID-derived client IP.

egressCidrs.description: Strict ASCII order, canonical IPv4/IPv6 network spelling with host bits zero and prefix greater than0; mapped IPv4 uses native dotted suffix.

hostAddresses.description: Strict ASCII order of canonical unicast IPs inside allowed CIDRs; includes actual selected endpoint IP. No resolution or resource-existence claim.

capabilityTokenSha256.description: Public selected association only; no raw token and no assertion that protected reservation/token ownership was verified.

destinationPath.description: Canonical absolute file path: no backslash, empty/dot/dotdot segments or trailing slash. No filesystem owner or existence claim.

podSelector.description: Actual paired verifier enforces Kubernetes label syntax: optional canonical lowercase DNS prefix then slash, name1..63 with alphanumeric ends and dash/dot/underscore interior; values empty or same name syntax. No resource-existence or namespace ownership claim.
